title: queryChanges position race: lock gap between ID fetch and position lookup
description: Message/queryChanges releases the store mutex after fetching changed IDs (message.rs lines 814-866), then re-acquires it per-message to call get_position_in_chat (lines 872-881). A write that lands between the lock release and the first re-acquisition inserts a new row, shifting positions of all previously-fetched IDs. The index returned for each added message is then off by the number of rows inserted in that window, producing a corrupted queryChanges response that misplaces messages in the client sort order.
